description: apcore Module -> MCP Tool, as built by MCPServerFactory.build_tool(). Pins SRS section 7.1 'MCP Tool Definition': name equals the module id with dot notation preserved, inputSchema is the module input schema, annotations are the four MCP behavioural hints.

test_cases.description: Dot notation is preserved in the MCP tool name. Hyphenation belongs to the OpenAI function-name normalizer (see openai_tool_mapping.json), not here.

The MCP path passes the input schema through; it does not promote x-llm-description or strip x- extensions. Both of those belong to the OpenAI strict conversion. Pins the boundary between the two paths.

known_gaps.description: F-041 acceptance criteria 1 and 5 say mcp_-prefixed keys from annotations.extra reach the MCP tool description and the Explorer detail view. In all three bridges AnnotationMapper.to_description_suffix() is called only from the OpenAI converter, never from build_tool(), so the MCP description never carries them. The three implementations agree, so this is a spec-versus-implementation gap rather than cross-language divergence. Covered on the OpenAI path by openai_tool_mapping.json#mcp_prefix_reaches_the_description.
